UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Contains the game state, coins, unlocked balls, and high scores for a player.

currentLevelIndex.description: The current level index the user is on

bestScores.description: Key-value pair of level index string to best score integer

resetUnlocked.description: Whether the player unlocked the game-end reset trigger

coins.description: Total coins accumulated by the player

unlockedBallIds.description: List of ball IDs unlocked in the shop

equippedBallId.description: ID of the currently selected/equipped golf ball

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last write

ExclusiveGrant.title: ExclusiveGrant
ExclusiveGrant.description: Exclusive skin grants issued directly by creator Martin to account names or email addresses.

targetIdentifier.description: Recipient email address or account name

targetType.description: Whether the target is an email or account username

setName.description: Name of the granted package (e.g. Net Set, Scribble Set, Complete Creator Bundle)

ballIds.description: List of exclusive ball IDs granted

trailIds.description: List of exclusive trail IDs granted

grantedBy.description: Creator email who granted the items

grantedAt.description: Timestamp when the grant was issued

users/{userId}.description: User profile containing persistent synced game progress.

exclusive_grants/{grantId}.description: Direct grants issued by Martin to user emails or account names.
